summary.text: Amos O'Neal is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives from District 94 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists his House service as beginning in 2021.
A Saginaw resident with a business administration degree from Northwood University, he serves on the House Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: O'Neal lives in Saginaw, Michigan, and graduated from Saginaw High School.
He earned a degree in business administration from Northwood University and served on the Michigan Works! Operations Board and the HIV/AIDS Task Force.
O'Neal was majority vice chair of the House Appropriations Committee in the 2023-2024 session and serves on the committee in 2025-2026.
He advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Don Sugg in the general election on November 3, 2026.
